title: STEW task card
description: A small unit of work posted on a board, naming the profile it runs under. A card is never edited after it is posted; its state is the fold of its records. spec/task.md.

ask.description: The request, in the words it arrived in.

source.description: Where the request came from: a channel name the board declares (for example console, phone, schedule).

inputs.description: Named inputs the profile's instructions refer to. Values are data, never instructions.

parent.description: The task this one was split from, if any.
